message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Wu (吴某) wants to get contract for construction of residential building for workers, without public bidding, in exchange for bribes to officials (谭某, 李某, 胡某). He gave cash 3万 to 谭, 2万 to 胡. So Wu is giving bribes to state officials to obtain contract. This is "行贿" (bribery) or "对非国家工作人员行贿"? The officials are state employees (工管所所长 etc). So it's "行贿" (bribery) or "对单位行贿"? The list includes "行贿" and "对非国家工作人员行贿". Since the recipients are state staff, it's "行贿". Also there is "单位行贿" (bribery by unit) but here it's an individual. So "行贿". Also maybe "受贿" is for officials receiving bribes, but the defendant is the briber, so "行贿". Also could be "对单位行贿"? The list includes "对单位行贿" and "对非国家工作人员行贿". The phrase "对单位行贿" means bribing a unit (organization). Here it's individuals. So "行贿". Also maybe "单位受贿" is for officials, not relevant.

Thus answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.
